Peonies are field crops unlocked at experience level 82.

They are used to make flower crowns, bouquets in the Flower Shop, floral candles and flower pendants.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for ??? coin.

Growing peonies

Peonies are grown in fields by planting another peony (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 7 experience points, and takes 4 hours to mature.

Selling peonies

  • Peonies can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 360 coin for 10 units.

Using peonies

Peonies are used to make the following products:


Flower Crown Candy Bouquet Birthday Bouquet
x5 x3 x3
Level 86 Level 90 Level 92
Soft Bouquet Floral Candle Flower Pendant
x4 x2 x3
Level 93 Level 95 Level 98
Clay Mug
x1
Level 99

Boat orders

Boat orders ask for 9 to 14 peonies per crate, up to a total of 44 per boat.

Strategy tips

Note: we have no tips yet for this item. You can help the Hay Day Wiki by adding your own.
